_doc: Operations clocks and the ONE deploy they run code from (OPS_CLOCKS_DEPLOY_ONE_PINNED_COPY; design/RimMandrake/operations_metronome_strategy_2026-11-02.md §8 step 0). Checked by src/RimMandrake/Utils/ops_clocks.py check. The deploy is the dispatch clone: nobody edits code there, it only fast-forwards to origin/main, and the ledger-writing clocks (dispatcher, restart, deadman) find their repo from their own file path, so their code and their data clone must be the same tree. Every rm-*, testq-*, timer-guard and account-plan unit systemd has loaded is either a clock here or named in outside with its reason; an unclassified one fails the check. A clock's trigger must exist; whether it is enabled is not judged here (account-plan.timer is off on the owner's order, 2026-10-29; timers_guard watches enabled timers).

outside.rm-relentless: the Relentless tick: its own belt (strategy §2 'Stay outside')
outside.rm-relentless-*: Relentless worker, check and stage runs: transient, launched by the Relentless tick
outside.rm-account-handover-*: one-shot account change-over armed by hand with systemd-run; stops itself (arm new ones from the deploy, see account_handover.py)
outside.testq-*: the RUNNER test queue lane, not an Operations clock
outside.rm-selftests-nightly: nightly selftests (strategy §2 'Stay outside'); runs in the Conductor's clone on purpose
outside.rm-agent-improve: a role's job, not an Operations clock
outside.rm-findings-judge: a role's job, not an Operations clock
outside.rm-codebase-health: codebase health publish, not an Operations clock
outside.rm-mirror: the D: mirror export, not an Operations clock
outside.rm-role-*: transient role runs (rm-role-<role>-<ts>: Conductor, Operations, ...), launched by systemd-run; ops_watch reads their result files
outside.rm-sheet-*: review-sheet servers an agent starts with systemd-run (src/RimMandrake/Utils/art/serve_gated.py): a page for the owner, not a clock
